cues.en: And so the big summer Gundam event,
came to a close, a huge success.
Even after the final battle, once the event was declared over,
many people stayed at the venue, savoring the afterglow,
and talked over the battles they had seen.
The huge life-size Gundam statue standing in Odaiba
simply looked down on the scene in silence...
But the dream system that lets you battle
with Gunpla you built yourself, the "Gunpla Battle Simulator",
Its developers will keep on improving it,
adding new systems so that you can play
in ways that are more real and more fun.
The world of Gunpla battle will keep on growing.
When that time comes, show us how you fight once more.
Everyone who loves Gunpla is waiting for you.
